subject: EK Electrical
notes: Topic taxonomy for the EK Electrical question bank (58 canonical questions, built from verified SQA/MCA past papers July 2016 - July 2026). Each question below maps to exactly one topic_id, matching the platform's topics table (id, subject_id, name). Use 'slug' as a stable reference key when writing the migration/seed script - it will not change even if question wording is refined later. 'merged_from' notes where multiple original UMTC-index question numbers turned out to be the same real underlying question. 'gap' notes where a topic was flagged as unverifiable against the official papers and is not included as a standalone canonical_answer.

verification_tiers.tier_1_full_official_source: Question text, diet date, and marker's report all verified directly against official SQA past paper PDFs. Applies to all questions with diets from Jul 2016 through Jul 2025 official papers processed earlier in this project.
verification_tiers.tier_2_screenshot_or_recollection: Diet confirmed via Marine Samraj screenshot or candidate's own attendance/memory, not the official marker's report. Applies to Oct 2025, Dec 2025, Mar 2026 additions, and Jul 2026 questions. Examiner Focus content is marked pending for these until an official marker's report is published and processed.
verification_tiers.tier_3_unverified_stem: Genuine marker's report commentary exists confirming the topic was tested, but the literal official question wording could not be confirmed due to a PDF extraction gap. Applies to 'why-reverse-power-protection-necessary' and 'iccp-system'.
